summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I checked before writing this (read-only) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  Findings so far: - **Backend looks correctly scoped.** Every watchlist route (list/create/get/update/delete/add-item/remove-item) filters or verifies `watchlists.user_id === userId` before touching data. Sessions are DB-backed (survive server restarts), 30-day cookie, `httpOnly`/`SameSite=Lax`. - **No local/anonymous fallback found.** `Wa
